target: A sleeve cuff or bag corner
frame: A fixed tabletop window, about 20 × 20 cm as an initial size to test
capture: The visitor checks the local preview and presses Capture. Crop to the selected window before model input or storage.
fallback: Offer a plain fabric cuff or bag panel, a prepared item photograph or a simple outline. Record the input route.
a: A captures C1, then C2 after a visitor-led fold or repositioning.
b: B uses one approved crop C as the canvas for a postcard that develops through a real conversation.
record: Keep source IDs, crop versions, actual AI inputs and outputs, actions or messages, and consented short reasons under a session code.
